text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
For an Umadol, it was an important event 
to express gratitude to the fans.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaah! Falco-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Hey everyone☆ Thanks for waiting!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to "Spend Time with Falco♪ 
Pure-Pure Valentine's Event"☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna send a whole bunch of love to 
everyone at the mini-live today♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And on our way back, the moment you've 
been waiting for! We've got chocolate 
souvenirs☆

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Dodged getting zero chocolates this 
year!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Chocolate from Falco is extra special, so 
you can count it as 100 pieces♪"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Handmade~?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Bzzzzt~. Falco is a top-notch idol, so 
with hygiene in mind, it's an assortment 
of store-bought goods☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But, it comes with a special bonus, so 
look forward to it♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, make sure to enjoy yourselves 
until the very end~! First up, let's kick 
things off with this song☆

And so, the Valentine's event proceeded 
smoothly...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Here you go, chocolates☆ Thanks for 
coming today♪

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!! There's a mini photo inside!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
A-And a maid outfit, no less...! A 
completely traditional, classic design!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: So cuuuuute!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A fresh shot for this event☆ I went for a 
Valentine's theme!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Moe?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: That was so moe!!!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Alright☆ You can post it on Umatter, so 
make sure to promote the race too, okay?♪
And...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Mmmh~! I did my best~!
choice_data_list: The last fan has headed home too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah, really? Then...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Not that! You still have one fan left 
right here.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yes. This one's for my very first fan!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Though it's the exact same 
chocolate as everyone else's☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still, getting a mini photo of you, 
Trainer... might actually be the grand 
prize♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe☆ Make sure to display it proudly♪

True to those words, inside was a photo 
with a handwritten message from Smart 
Falcon—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"To Fan #1, Happy Valentine's ☆ From your 
Falco"

Smart Falcon in a maid outfit was 
surrounded by a sea of hand-drawn hearts.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Look, Fan Number 1! Trainer-san is still 
hereâ

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yes. This one's for you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The contents are the same as everyone 
else's, but the bonus gift is a little 
different.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
An umadol's Valentine's Day belongs to her 
fans. That's Falco's rule!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So, I won't give the 'true-feeling' 
chocolate that holds special meaning to 
anyone, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A medley filled with 'thank yous' is my 
extra bonus gift to you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's a special setlist different from the 
mini-live. I'm positive you'll love it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“—Will you accept it? Falco's true 
feelings.”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thank you♪ Now then, please listen.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Just for you... a special present ☆

Thanks to Smart Falcon's singing, which 
felt just a little sweeter than usual, I 
was able to spend a truly happy 
Valentine's Day...
